content.headline: PLAY WITHOUT EXPIRATION.
content.subhead: In the world's toughest terrains, a broken shoe is a broken promise. We engineer Nike footwear to survive 1,200km of monsoon mud and jagged rock so that for these children, play never has to stop.
content.graphic_caption: SURVIVAL DATA: While standard shoes degrade at 400km, our soles retain 79% traction after 1,200km. Built to outlast the journey.
